payload.body: You tend to stay controlled until a conversation reaches the subject nobody is supposed to name. Then your response becomes more intense because the issue has been affecting decisions for a long time without being discussed. Underneath is often the belief that being exposed would give someone else power over you. State the fact before secrecy becomes the main source of control.
